WITH player_vote_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pav.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    CASE 
      WHEN pav.points_max IS NOT NULL AND pav.points_max > 0 AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL
      THEN pav.points_won / pav.points_max
    END as ratio
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  LEFT JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.player_id IS NOT NULL
),
valid_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    COALESCE(death_country, '') as death_country,
    ratio
  FROM player_vote_ratios
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
),
player_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    death_country,
    AVG(ratio) as player_avg
  FROM valid_ratios
  GROUP BY player_id, death_country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    AVG(player_avg) as country_avg
  FROM player_averages
  GROUP BY death_country
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.death_country,
  ca.country_avg,
  ca.country_avg / om.overall_avg as ratio_to_mean
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY ca.death_country
